decisions.reason: The song description faithfully preserves the present-over-past/future contrast, burning-life imagery, and fleeting-light prayer.
The gentle, graceful, breeze-like freedom and changing-wind melody are preserved naturally.
The uncontrollable heartbeat, takeoff imagery, destination of longing, and Take Off☆ token are preserved.
The unforgettable wish, unyielding dream, preserving one's former self, and song continuing until the indomitable cherry blossom blooms are all retained.
The party-like slangy energy, sun metaphor, and playful request for the interlude are preserved in an appropriately casual register.
The light but edgy musical character and the plea not to forget past pain are preserved, including negation.
Gold Ship's nickname is correctly resolved, and the playful RAP invitation and excited tone are preserved.
The first-magnitude-star imagery, inherited wish, brightest radiance, and dream renewal are conveyed faithfully.
The importance of an ordinary day, embracing it, dreaming of tomorrow, and final good-night line are natural and complete.
The youthful dedication to a cherished rival, refusal to lose, and challenge to settle the contest are faithfully preserved.
